set system host-name ASG2.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols ptp domain 255.explanation: Configures the domain number of the PTP protocol.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.explanation: The PTP protocol domain number, which distinguishes between different PTP domains.

set protocols ptp interface ge-0/0/0.explanation: Configure the interface for the PTP protocol.

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface used in the PTP protocol, e.g. g-1/0/0.0.

clock-source internal.explanation: Configures the clock source for the PTP interface.

clock-priority 1.explanation: Configures the clock priority of the PTP interface.

parameters.name: clock-priority
parameters.explanation: The clock priority is higher the smaller the value priority.

domain 255.explanation: Configure the field of the PTP interface.

parameters.name: domain
parameters.explanation: The field number of the PTP protocol.

delay-mechanism delay.explanation: Configure the delay mechanism for the PTP interface.

parameters.name: delay-mechanism
parameters.explanation: Type of mechanism to delay, e.g., Delay.

unit 0.explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family ethernet-switching port-mode acce.explanation: Configure the interface 's port mode is trunk.
